title: Farmers Market of the Ozarks
notes: Verified on loveyourfarmer.com (farmersmarketoftheozarks.com does not resolve). Springfield Farmers Park is Saturdays year-round. The calendar page says open 8-1 every Saturday and 9-1 during winter. This entry is the 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. season, from the Saturday closest to March 21 through the Saturday before Thanksgiving, approximated as 03-21 to 11-21. The downtown market page says it is closed.
